all_ranked.title: THE CROWD CHOOSES BARABBAS
all_ranked.hook: Never seek justice from a crowd. A mob does not want truth; it wants blood.
all_ranked.reality: The collective mind is blind, hysterical, and easily guided by demagogues. They will crown you king on Sunday and cheer your public execution by Friday morning.
all_ranked.mechanism: A crowd possesses zero conscience. Responsibility is diluted across thousands of screaming faces, allowing cowards to commit atrocities they would never dare alone.
all_ranked.truth: The most dangerous illusion is believing public consensus equals moral righteousness.
all_ranked.outro: Never adjust your compass by the roar of the arena. Stand alone, or be swallowed by the herd.

all_ranked.title: THE KINGMAKER DILEMMA
all_ranked.hook: Notice who stopped clapping when you started winning.
all_ranked.reality: People love supporting you when you are struggling because your misery flatters their superiority. They will happily play the protector as long as you stay beneath them.
all_ranked.mechanism: The moment you outgrow the pedestal built by your mentor, their encouragement curdles into quiet resentment. An ally rarely forgives you for becoming their superior.
all_ranked.truth: The knife that cuts the deepest is never held by a stranger. It is wielded by the ally who believed they owned your future.
all_ranked.outro: Build your kingdom with those who celebrate your crown, not those who demand rent for helping you lay the bricks.

all_ranked.title: THE COMFORT CAGE
all_ranked.hook: A comfortable salary is the drug employers give you to forget your ambition.
all_ranked.reality: You tell yourself it is only temporary—just until you pay down the debt, just until you buy the car. But decade by decade, the gilded cage shrinks around you.
all_ranked.mechanism: The modern empire does not shackle your wrists with iron; it sedates your mind with convenience, direct deposits, and subscription entertainment.
all_ranked.truth: You are not safe. You are merely well-fed livestock inside an economic pasture designed to harvest your prime years.
all_ranked.outro: Either build your own vessel today, or spend your entire life rowing someone else's galleon into the sunset.

all_ranked.title: THE TRANSACTIONAL TRUTH
all_ranked.hook: Nobody loves you for who you are. They love what you bring to the table.
all_ranked.reality: Strip away your usefulness, your income, your energy, and your humor. Watch how quickly the warmest room turns ice cold.
all_ranked.mechanism: Every human relationship is an unwritten contract of mutual leverage. When your value drops to zero, sentimentality evaporates into thin air.
all_ranked.truth: Do not weep over the transactional nature of humanity. Master it, so you are never left begging at an empty banquet.
all_ranked.outro: Make sure you always own the table everyone else wants to sit at.

all_ranked.title: THE ARCHITECT OF CHAOS
all_ranked.hook: Never reveal your competence too early. It only earns you more work and more enemies.
all_ranked.reality: The overachiever rushes forward with solutions and instantly inherits everyone else's neglected burdens. The wise strategist plays the fool and studies the board.
all_ranked.mechanism: When people underestimate your intellect, they speak freely in front of you. They lower their shields and hand you the keys to their weaknesses.
all_ranked.truth: Appearing harmless is the most lethal armor in history. It lets you strike from point-blank range.
all_ranked.outro: Hide your brilliance behind a mask of simplicity until the moment of irreversible victory.

all_ranked.title: THE MYTH OF KARMA
all_ranked.hook: Karma is the comforting fairy tale weak men tell themselves to avoid fighting back.
all_ranked.reality: The universe does not balance ledgers. Tyrants die peacefully in silk sheets, while the righteous starve in forgotten trenches waiting for cosmic retribution.
all_ranked.mechanism: Justice is not a mystical law of physics; it is an act of human will and concentrated power. Waiting for karma is merely outsourcing your courage to the sky.
all_ranked.truth: The wicked do not trip over their own shadows. They reign until someone with superior force strips the sceptre from their hands.
all_ranked.outro: Stop praying for the storm to strike your enemy. Become the lightning yourself.

all_ranked.title: THE PRICE OF CONSTANT AVAILABILITY
all_ranked.hook: If you are always available, you will always be undervalued.
all_ranked.reality: You answer every call on the first ring and solve emergencies that aren't yours. You think you are dependable; they think you have nothing better to do.
all_ranked.mechanism: Human psychology only prizes what is scarce. Water in a desert is worth a fortune; water from an overflowing gutter is ignored and stepped on.
all_ranked.truth: When your presence costs nothing, your absence leaves no void.
all_ranked.outro: Make yourself scarce. Only what can be lost is ever cherished.

all_ranked.title: THE STEALTH WEALTH PARADOX
all_ranked.hook: Poor people buy luxury to look rich. Powerful people stay invisible to stay dangerous.
all_ranked.reality: The moment you flash gold and designer logos, you paint a target on your back. You announce to competitors and envious relatives exactly what you have.
all_ranked.mechanism: Ego demands an audience; sovereignty requires anonymity. When your wealth is silent, enemies fight in the dark against an adversary they cannot measure.
all_ranked.truth: Flashing your treasure is the amateur's tax. It buys temporary envy at the price of permanent vulnerability.
all_ranked.outro: Accumulate absolute power in silence, and let fools drown in their rented jewelry.

all_ranked.title: THE SINNER ON THE FRONT PEW
all_ranked.hook: The louder someone proclaims their virtue, the darker the rot in their basement.
all_ranked.reality: The most ruthless hypocrites always wear the brightest robes. They police everyone else's morality to distract the crowd from inspecting their own hands.
all_ranked.mechanism: Public sanctimony is an ancient armor. It shields the predator behind a wall of righteous indignation, daring anyone to question the crusader.
all_ranked.truth: Genuine integrity is quiet and private. Loud morality is almost always an alibi.
all_ranked.outro: Beware the man holding the collection plate. He usually counts the gold with the curtains closed.

all_ranked.title: THE COWARD'S PERFUME
all_ranked.hook: Being agreeable is not kindness. It is cowardice wearing perfume.
all_ranked.reality: You swallow your tongue and smile through insults, believing compliance makes you noble. But the world never respects a doormat; it merely wipes its muddy boots on it.
all_ranked.mechanism: Predators do not attack the strong; they hunt the predictable. When you never say no, your yes becomes completely worthless in every negotiation.
all_ranked.truth: Kindness without teeth is not virtue. It is helplessness masquerading as morality.
all_ranked.outro: Grow your claws first. Only then is your restraint a choice.
